svg.title: research:design workflow
svg.desc: Animated walk through one design research: the chat, the tools and subagents, and the files each step writes.
svg.text: research:design — one research, end to end
double border = fresh subagent, never sees the chat

g.text: The problem, as I understand it:
Q1: no. Remarks: it must also …
starts the log, asks about situation + requirements
given only Problem + Requirements and a lens:
only for a large problem in a project
not told the leader; sees no verdicts
told the leader; tests each rejection
on the question tool: blocks until the checklist is done
A design question arrives in the chat.
Phase 1 · problem-formulation starts the log and confirms the problem with the user.
Phase 2 · each requirement is a need with a reason and priority; a mechanism in one becomes an option.
Phase 3 · fresh generator subagents, given only Problem + Requirements, look for options.
Each report is saved; add-candidates.py makes every option its own row. Then the researcher adds its own.
Phase 4 · score every option, write rejection records and harms, draft the leader.
log-sections.py cuts one extract per check: the bias check never learns which option leads.
Phase 5 · the round checklist is ticked; the round-gate hook blocks questions until it is done.
The report and the questions go to the user, with Remarks last.
Phase 2 again · the answers drop, add or replace requirements; dropped rows move to rounds.md.
Next round: re-score, new options, checks, report. Rounds stop when nothing new turns up.
Phase 6 · the decision is drafted and reviewed in open chat.
Only after the review: implement, step by step.
